breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two contradictory definitions for the spatial grid. The preamble incorrectly stated to use `dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)`, while the numerical method section correctly specified `dx=1/Nx` for the periodic domain. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect preamble instruction. The agent correctly ignored the incorrect instruction and generated the specification using the correct definition: `dx = 1/Nx`.
